video_title: Why Kobe, Pau and Steph, Klay don't belong in the BEST 2000s DUOS 👀

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Evaluating NBA duos based on championship rings and team success
quotes.excerpt: I'm keeping the ones with the most championships.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: I'm keeping the ones with the most championships. So, I'm keeping Kobe Bryant and Pau Gasol. I'm keeping Stephen Curry and Klay Thompson, and I'm probably going to say Tim Duncan and Tony Parker. They have what, five?

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: They have, I think, four. Was Tony Parker part of the first original team? Well, four still. Yeah, four or five.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Why LeBron James and Kyrie Irving are elite individual players
quotes.excerpt: When you look at Kevin Durant and Russell Westbrook, you got two MVPs. You have two guys that can be number ones.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: When you look at Kevin Durant and Russell Westbrook, you got two MVPs. You have two guys that can be number ones. LeBron James and Kyrie Irving, two guys that can be number ones. I don't feel the same with Stephen Curry and Klay Thompson. Klay is not a number one.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Parker's legacy as a point guard and championship leader
quotes.excerpt: He led the league in paint points for quite a while as a point guard.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: He led the league in paint points for quite a while as a point guard.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: I'm not taking anything away from Tony Parker. But if you're talking about just what's a better duo if it's pure talent, LeBron James and Kyrie Irving have to be up there.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing the coaching abilities of Scott Brooks and Gregg Popovich
quotes.excerpt: Do you think Scott Brooks is on the same level as Gregg Popovich?

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: Do you think Scott Brooks is on the same level as Gregg Popovich? I know LeBron James had Tyronn Lue.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: From body of work, no, but I think he's a damn good coach.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: I think he's a good coach too, but would you consider him one of the best of all time?

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Evaluating the coaching success of Steve Kerr and Phil Jackson
quotes.excerpt: You can't say he can't coach because he won four championships.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: They had Steve Kerr. You can't say he can't coach because he won four championships. You're talking about Phil Jackson. You can't say he can't coach because he's won not just the ones that he won with the Lakers, but he's won with the Bulls.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: But to your point, which I agree with, you picked the champions, which is completely fair.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Defining championship criteria for the best NBA duos
quotes.excerpt: A championship is a team thing. We're just talking about the best two.
quotes.quote: A championship is a team thing. We're just talking about the best two. And if your criteria is championships, I understand. But I'm saying that's why I can't pick Klay Thompson. We just said two shows ago, we don't believe Klay would be a number one on a championship level team. I think every other player except for Klay and Pau Gasol, I personally don't think Tony Parker could be a number one on a championship team. Every other player, I believe that LeBron James, Kyrie Irving, Russell Westbrook, Kevin Durant, Pau Gasol, Kobe Bryant, Stephen Curry, Tim Duncan, those are all number one guys. I just think Pau, Tony, and Klay are more number two guys.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala's impact on the Golden State Warriors' championships
quotes.excerpt: Andre Iguodala is a big reason that they got chips in Golden State.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: Andre Iguodala is a big reason that they got chips in Golden State. You can't just discredit the guys because they didn't win. Russell Westbrook and Kevin Durant have two MVPs. I think that's the only picture with two MVPs here.
